ticks.note: Tick 1: `lamp` = (`false` or `false`) and not `false`: off. In tick 1, `pre(lamp)` is `false`.
Pressed: `button` makes the bracket true and `arrived` is false: on, in the tick of the press.
Released: `pre(lamp)` keeps the bracket true. The previous tick's lamp holds the lamp on.
`arrived`: `&& !arrived` switches the lamp off, whatever the bracket says.
A press while the lift is here: `!arrived` keeps the lamp off.
The lift leaves; `pre(lamp)` is false, so the lamp stays off.
Press and arrival in the same tick: the arrival wins.
